user.title: Add a WiZ test bulb
user.description: Experimental integration. Native transitions were verified on ESP24_SHRGB_01 firmware 1.36.1. Low dimming scales LED channels and is approximate; it does not preserve dynamic effects. Keep both options off on untested devices until ready to test.
